compiled_state.title: Add CI dry-run comment shape check step to calibration-rollup.yml
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## What / Why

Story 9713 DD-3 requires calibration-rollup.yml to have a CI step that performs a dry-run and asserts the comment shape matches the expected format. Currently no such step exists.

## Files to Modify

- .github/workflows/calibration-rollup.yml: add a step (on push events) that:
  1. Runs calibration-report.sh mutation-append --pr ${GH_SHA} --findings 5 --dry-run
  2. Captures the output
  3. Asserts the output contains the idempotency marker header (e.g., "calibration:mutation-append" or equivalent)
  Step name: "Dry-run comment shape check"
  
  Check calibration-report.sh --dry-run output format to determine the correct assertion pattern.

- tests/scripts/test-calibration-rollup-workflow.sh: add assertion that the workflow contains "Dry-run comment shape check" step

## Story DD Coverage

- dd-3: calibration-rollup.yml CI dry-run posts the expected comment shape to a test ticket and asserts the shape matches

## Given / When / Then

Given calibration-rollup.yml with the dry-run check step
When the step runs with --dry-run flag
Then the output contains the expected idempotency marker and the step exits 0

## Testing Mode

RED — structural test first, then implement

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: calibration-rollup.yml contains "Dry-run comment shape check" step before mutation-append
- AC2: The step invokes calibration-report.sh mutation-append with --dry-run
- AC3: The step asserts the output contains the idempotency marker
- AC4: Structural test in test-calibration-rollup-workflow.sh verifies the step is present
